scope: Private local synthetic assistance and evaluation; no autonomous approval or publication.

input.adapter: Optional trusted synchronous local callable(text,language). No import/install/network/model discovery or runtime timeout enforcement occurs in this helper.

manifest.provenance: Trusted configuration declaration only; syntax validation does not verify installed artifact identity.

finding.offset_unit: Python Unicode code points; start inclusive/end exclusive, not UTF-8 bytes.
finding.bounds: Strict integers excluding booleans; 0 <= start < end <= len(text).
finding.score: NULL or finite numeric [0,1], excluding booleans; reviewed recognizer-specific semantics. NULL when no meaningful score exists. Never disclosure safety probability.
finding.duplicates: Reject duplicate (entity,start,end); distinct overlapping spans permitted.

helper.failure_findings: Non-completed results must have empty spans; fixed codes contain no exception/source text.
helper.completed_findings: Valid manifest and findings required even for zero detections; complete human review remains required.

evaluation.manifest: Canonical SHA-256 JSON fingerprint plus exact sorted case membership per split; duplicate IDs, declared cross-split family and exact-text overlap rejected.
evaluation.ground_truth_limit: Generated labels/templates and declared family separation are preparation only. Near-duplicate families/language realism and independent labels remain unverified; evaluation designation is not an untouched held-out study.
evaluation.matching: Exact (entity,start,end); wrong overlapping boundaries contribute FP and FN.
evaluation.coverage: Metrics describe completed detector cases only; manual/failed counts and fixed codes remain explicit and must accompany metrics. Unsupported-language completed observations are invalid.
evaluation.private_aggregate: Counts, synthetic case IDs, validated engine metadata and fingerprints only; no source text, findings, offsets, substrings or scores.
evaluation.leakage_probe_limit: Optional exact synthetic forbidden-substring check is incomplete; it cannot certify profile permissions, paraphrase/encoding safety or API/browser/cache disclosure.

runtime_requirements: Pin and verify local recognizer/model/package/configuration artifacts in a separate reviewed optional integration; no implicit install/download.
Provide actual timeout/process/resource isolation; the synchronous helper cannot interrupt a hung adapter.

Missing, failed, uncertain or unsupported assistance stays private/manual, never an empty successful detection result. Any explicit choice of established rule-only workflow remains visible and separately reviewed.
Preserve existing deterministic projection when assistance is deliberately disabled; no detector finding or absence may widen recipient fields.

Before quality claims: two independent label reviews/disagreements, near-duplicate family review, frozen corpus/policy/engine/config/splits, untouched held-out cases and separate one-engine comparison runs.
All candidates still require existing exact source/candidate/policy/profile/channel-bound human approval. Changed inputs invalidate approval; failures never publish.
